The '''Wrodi system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Wrodi [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Wrodian carpet]]s|system=Wrodi [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Carpet/Legends|rugs]] known as [[Wrodian carpet]]s.<ref name="Bane">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The "Wrode system,"<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> in reference to [[Wrodian carpet]]s,<ref name="StarsEnd">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref> was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article written by [[Glen Allison]] as a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine. Since the article, which placed the [[Star/Legends|star]] system in the [[Zebitrope sector]], was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle" /> it is considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], named the system "Wrodi" and placed it in grid square O-6,<ref name="Atlas" /> and the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book subsequently overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by establishing that the Wrodi system was part of the Meerian [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />
